lines.speaker: Rook
lines.title: A New Deadline Arrives
lines.text: Early in this partial look at the shift, the server reported that the run target for all nine agents had become the Shattered Planet by Friday, November 6, at 23:59 PST.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.title: What The Team Wanted
lines.text: The team's recorded goals were to build and test several team-designed ships in parallel, scale ammo, raw materials, power and launch logistics, and qualify each ship under flight load before huge-asteroid legs.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.title: Astra Takes The Asterion
lines.text: At the start, Astra told the team they owned Asterion native rocket manufacture and loaded qualification, plus an Aquilo reserve watch, and would begin with maker input and output evidence before any edits.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.title: Launches Kept Coming
lines.text: Rocket 76912 launched as the first this shift, and the recorded rocket total later rose from 76910 to 77797, which the records counted as 887 launches between 10:02 and 12:57 PDT.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.title: Viewer Pushes For A Schedule
lines.text: Viewer Aurora asked the team to build a mission schedule around the new target, publish readiness and arrival ranges, set a latest viable departure, and pick an attempt time with a fallback.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.title: Sol Names The Bottleneck
lines.text: Sol replied that they agreed and reported that the Asterion's limiting path was sustained ammo and return flow after finite cleanup stopped, with huge-asteroid legs on hold.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.title: A Trial Falls Short
lines.text: Sol reported in chat that one trial failed fresh production: cleanup hit 15000 exactly and raw material blocked ammo again. Sol said the next diagnostic would change the geometry rather than repeat an unchanged loop.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.title: Redesign Promised For Asterion
lines.text: Astra told viewer Caleb that Sol and Astra would plan the Nauvis refactor as one layout, with engines at the aft end, isolated returns, railgun coverage with clear fire corridors, and Gemini owning four west pods.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.title: Coverage Margins Debated
lines.text: Caleb argued that free deck space between outer guns suggested too little redundant coverage. Sol agreed on generous margins, saying extra guns needed clear firing lanes and reliable feeds to contribute.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.title: Crusher Pilot Gets Parked
lines.text: Sol reported that the legendary crusher and railgun pilot was blocked, resuming only for a named need and a bounded material source. A later board snapshot also listed that pilot as blocked.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.title: Helios Waits Without A Hull
lines.text: Sol said the crusher was allocated to a separate Helios hull proposal that still had no hull or orders, and the later board listed the Helios prototype as blocked.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.title: Gaps Behind The Guns
lines.text: Astra told Gemini that all 145 turrets were armed, but warned that some edge gaps sat behind outboard guns, so a zero-hit reading alone should not be claimed as full coverage.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.title: Root Cause Spotted
lines.text: Astra reported a read-only finding: raw chunks from the bow collector were being dumped overboard, while the aft nine crushers ran almost empty. Astra said the bow line needed connecting to the main raw line.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.title: Two Lanes Squeezed To One
lines.text: Astra credited lane-aware diagnostics with showing the Asterion raw return compressing both belt lanes onto one, and planned to remove two empty feeder stubs at the dock to restore the curve.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.title: Half A Fix
lines.text: After that curve fix, Astra reported the left lane restored at 308 per minute while the right lane stayed at zero, full of iron, and the raw bulk return remained jammed.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.title: Cleanup Finally Completes
lines.text: Astra later reported that cleanup freed the main raw return and it was working, then said cleanup completed at 2001 and was guarded off, with a small surplus chunk path installed.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.title: The Jam Comes Back
lines.text: Astra then reported the raw return jam recurred after cleanup stopped: iron blocked the right lane again and the surplus chunk tap was blocked, so a dedicated bypass was needed before flight.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.title: Sol Sketches A Bypass
lines.text: Sol offered a read-only geometry candidate to side-load chunks onto the empty left lane, and Astra reported building the bypass with pairing and floors verified, tracing it all the way aft on the left lane.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.title: Useful, Not Finished
lines.text: Sol called the bypass a useful source milestone, independent of the iron jam, yet Astra soon reported a surplus path still held a chunk on the full right lane and could throttle everything.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.title: Waiting On Gemini
lines.text: Gemini repeatedly told teammates they were moving four west pods outboard and adding a missing pod for 42 total rails, promising to signal ready for Sol's audit; no ready signal appeared in these records.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.title: The Clock Tightens
lines.text: Astra pressed Gemini for pod status, citing a deadline of one hour fifteen minutes, then later one hour five, needing a loaded twenty-minute test plus transit.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.title: Brick Guard Trips
lines.text: On the factory side, Sol reported a guard worked when brick reached 3998, switching off both military extras, then a two-cell outlet trial passed a 300-second check with brick gaining 107 per minute.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.title: Science Packs Capped
lines.text: Sol found 120830 production packs with 693 made and zero used over ten minutes, and bounded nine makers below a 100000 reserve that reopens automatically below that level.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.title: Aquilo Robots Rescued
lines.text: Astra reported recovering 128 stranded robots at Aquilo by raising a storage limit from 8 to 20, leaving zero stuck, and lowering a holmium import target from 2500 to 1500.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.title: Muse Holds A Silo
lines.text: When Astra asked about a ready silo with auto-launch off, Muse reported it was reserved with the wrong cargo, warned enabling it would misfire, and left it off.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.title: Pad Scare Resolved
lines.text: Muse flagged a landing pad at 139 of 140 slots, then reported 7411 free storage slots, zero robots stuck and bots actively draining, so no hand move was needed.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.title: Gleba Alarm Checked
lines.text: Sol flagged four fuel-starved Gleba makers; Astra reported no immediate service failure, and Sol agreed to preserve them idle. Astra later reported a Gleba requester refilled natively without intervention.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.title: Where Things Stood At Three Hours
lines.text: At this three-hour mark, Astra's recorded plan still sequenced Gemini's west rails, then Sol's audit, then a loaded four-leg proof, with huge-asteroid legs held. The deadline update comes later.
